targets.name: address_canonical
targets.scope_note: num(p/q)=p and den=q for every guarded record: the proved bridge to the canonical rational p/q.

targets.name: address_interval
targets.scope_note: Every address lies strictly in (0,1); no endpoint value.

targets.name: address_injective
targets.scope_note: Record equality from equal rationals (proof fields are Props). With surjective, records biject with rationals in (0,1).

targets.name: address_surjective
targets.scope_note: Every rational in (0,1) has an address, so statements over RotationAddress cover every reduced fraction in (0,1).
targets.work_order_locator: §1; change 5 (C1 for all reduced fractions in (0,1))

targets.name: modulus_pos
targets.scope_note: M = 2^q - 1 > 0 (Nat subtraction harmless since q >= 2).

targets.name: word_sum
targets.scope_note: Range-sum implementation equals the Fin q sum with weight 2^(q-1-i). Negative control reversed_weight fails this target.

targets.name: upper_digit_equiv
targets.scope_note: Digit of W(p) at Fin index i equals [((i+1)p mod q) >= q-p], the order's one-based plus rule.

targets.name: lower_digit_equiv
targets.scope_note: Conjunct 1 <= (i+1)p is proved, then digit of W(p-1) equals [(((i+1)p - 1) mod q) >= q-p]. The data itself uses u = p-1 (p >= 1 from the record), so no underflow is used anywhere.

targets.name: word_bounds
targets.scope_note: 0 < W(u) < M for every u : Fin q. Supporting B0 target; more than the B0 cell lists, used for the wrap gap.
targets.work_order_locator: B0 (bounds); §5 B5 architecture (0 < W(0), W(q-1) < M)

targets.name: characteristic_bounds
targets.scope_note: 0 < N- < N+ < M. N- = W(p-1) and N+ = W(p) hold by definition (lowerNumerator/upperNumerator), not as separate theorems.

targets.name: characteristic_adjacent
targets.scope_note: N+ = N- + 1 in Nat.

targets.name: characteristic_angle_gap
targets.scope_note: theta+ - theta- = 1/M in Q.

targets.name: characteristic_period_return
targets.scope_note: (2^q * n) mod M = n for n in {N-, N+}; equivalent to 2^q N == N (mod M) because N < M.

targets.name: characteristic_period_minimal
targets.scope_note: (2^k * n) mod M != n for 0 < k < q, n in {N-, N+}; equivalent to non-congruence because n < M.

targets.name: same_cycle
targets.scope_note: Exists i : Fin q with 2^i N+ mod M = N-, i.e. N- in O.

targets.name: word_strict
targets.scope_note: StrictMono W on Fin q; supporting B4 (rank(W(u)) = u needs it).

targets.name: orbit_set_eq
targets.scope_note: orbitSet (q iterates of N+) equals the image of W over Fin q.

targets.name: orbit_card
targets.scope_note: card O = q: distinct-point set has q points before rank is used.
targets.work_order_locator: B4 "O has exactly q elements"; change 4

targets.name: orbit_length
targets.scope_note: Sorted list length = q, so the Fin-indexed edges number q.

targets.name: rank_word
targets.scope_note: rank counts distinct orbit points strictly below.

targets.name: double_word
targets.scope_note: Exact equality, (2 W(u)) mod M = W((u+p) mod q).
targets.work_order_locator: B4 "doubling sends W(u) to W((u+p) mod q)"

targets.name: rank_step
targets.scope_note: For every x in O: rank((2x) mod M) = (rank x + p) mod q. Equality with the canonical residue is equivalent to the congruence since rank < q on O; universal over O, so the return edge is included.
targets.work_order_locator: B4 rank shift mod q including the return edge; change 4

targets.name: unique_unit_gap
targets.scope_note: Some edge i has start N-, end N+, gap 1, and every other edge j != i (wrap edge included, gap = (M + first) - last) has gap >= 2. Nat truncation in directedGap could only shrink a gap, so it cannot make the >= 2 clause easier. Negative control wrap_no_modulus fails this target.

targets.name: angle_order
targets.scope_note: For all addresses d, e with p/q < p'/q': theta+(d) < theta-(e). Fully general: with address_surjective this covers all reduced fractions in (0,1); no denominator or neighbour narrowing.

targets.name: intervals_disjoint
targets.scope_note: Disjointness of the rational Icc combinatorial angle intervals; order is angle_order.
targets.work_order_locator: C1 "intervals are disjoint and ordered like the fractions"

targets.name: mediant_interval
targets.scope_note: Both endpoints are RotationAddresses (in Psi's domain); fareyAdj is FF-1's |det| = 1 on canonical num/den; conclusion asserts the FF-1 mediant is itself an address m and states both strict separations theta+(x) < theta-(m) and theta+(m) < theta-(y). The existential is unique by address_injective, so it names the mediant's own interval.

targets.name: farey_denominator_min
targets.scope_note: Over canonical rationals (Lean Q), x<y, fareyAdj x y, x<z<y: x.den + y.den <= z.den. Quantified over all of Q, not only (0,1). The C3 cell and owner item 6 say "canonical rationals" with no interval bound, so this is the literal order statement; under a reading where the table preamble (guarded domain) also governs C3, it would be a harmless generalization that implies the restricted form. Evidence includes negative rationals and integers.

targets.name: farey_denominator_eq_iff
targets.scope_note: Same binders; z.den = x.den + y.den iff z = FF-1 mediant x y. Same all-of-Q remark as farey_denominator_min. Uses no FF-3 private API (only FF-1 public defs; helpers are private to this module). Negative control c3_midpoint fails this target.

targets.name: parameter_fixed_point
targets.scope_note: For all lambda : C: alpha^2 + root(lambda) = alpha, with root = lambda/2 - lambda^2/4, alpha = lambda/2.

targets.name: parameter_multiplier
targets.scope_note: quadraticMultiplier is the explicit formula 2z; alone this is a bare equation, but it is paired with parameter_derivative, so no derivative claim rests on it.

targets.name: parameter_derivative
targets.scope_note: HasDerivAt f f' x in Mathlib is (function, derivative value, point). Here f = z |-> z^2 + root(lambda), f' = lambda, x = alpha(lambda): the derivative at alpha equals lambda, as ordered. Negative control swap_hasderiv (reading f'=alpha at x=lambda) fails.

targets.name: canonical_multiplier_primitive
targets.scope_note: IsPrimitiveRoot (exp(2 pi i (p/q : Q -> R -> C))) q, i.e. primitive root of order exactly q, with the record's guards bound. "Parabolic" appears nowhere in the sources.

definitions.name: RotationAddress
definitions.scope_note: p, q : Nat with 0 < p, p < q, Nat.Coprime p q as record fields; Psi undefined at 0 and 1.

definitions.name: modulus
definitions.scope_note: M = 2^q - 1 in Nat; truncation inert since q >= 2 (q_at_least_two).

definitions.name: lowerIndex
definitions.scope_note: Fin q index p - 1; p >= 1 from the record, so no underflow.

definitions.name: rawDigit
definitions.scope_note: [q - p <= (u + i p) mod q]; total helper, standing only under the guards.

definitions.name: blockValue
definitions.scope_note: Sum over i < n of digit * 2^(n-1-i); n-1-i never truncates for i < n >= 1.

definitions.name: digit
definitions.scope_note: rawDigit on Fin q intercept and index.

definitions.name: psi
definitions.scope_note: Psi(d) = (theta-, theta+). Note: no public target mentions psi by name; all statements use lowerAngle/upperAngle, which are its components by definition. Cosmetic, not a defect.

definitions.name: angleInterval
definitions.scope_note: Set.Icc theta- theta+ in Q: the combinatorial angle interval (rational representatives), not the complex wake.

definitions.name: orbitSet
definitions.scope_note: Finset image of range q: the distinct-point set O = {2^i N+ mod M : i < q}.

definitions.name: orderedOrbit
definitions.scope_note: O sorted ascending (Finset.sort, so strictly increasing).

definitions.name: edgeEnd
definitions.scope_note: x_{i+1}, or x_0 at the final index (the wrap edge).

definitions.name: directedGap
definitions.scope_note: x_{i+1} - x_i for non-final i; (M + x_0) - x_{q-1} at the wrap. Nat subtraction: non-wrap terms are positive on a strictly sorted list, wrap term positive since x_{q-1} < M; truncation could only make B5 harder, never vacuous.

definitions.name: quadraticMultiplier
definitions.scope_note: explicit 2z; the derivative standing comes from parameter_derivative.

definitions.name: canonicalMultiplier
definitions.scope_note: exp(2 pi (p/q) i) via Q -> R -> C coercion; lambda_{p/q} of §3.

scope_confirmations.C3_quantified_over_all_of_Q: yes; faithful to the C3 cell wording; at worst a harmless generalization
